text:
morgan: quick sync — i sketched the telemetry we need to tune continuous batching heuristics (batch formation, queue policies, token-budget targets). want to align before i proto the dashboard. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

anya: love it. high level: what KPIs are non-negotiable for the SLOs?

morgan: 3 core KPI groups: batch-level (size, utilization, fill-time), queue-level (depth, age, priority-breakdown), token throughput (tokens/sec per GPU + per-route). secondary: kv-cache (hit/miss, evictions) and tail latencies.

devon: to be concrete, suggesting PromQLs for baseline panels — feel free to copy: 

```promql
// median and p95 batch size across serving nodes
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))

// batch utilization = tokens_served / (max_batch_size * batches) approx
sum(rate(tokens_emitted[1m])) by (node) / (sum(rate(batch_count[1m])) by (node) * max_batch_size)

// queue depth per model + seq_len bucket
sum(queue_depth) by (model, seq_len_bucket)

// tokens/sec per GPU
sum(rate(tokens_emitted[1m])) by (gpu_type)
```

jules: nice. add kvcache-specific signals: hit_rate, miss_rate, eviction_count, and avg_kv_bytes. also want a metric for cache-warmth per-request to understand cold-start amplification.

morgan: agree. proposed kvcache queries:

```promql
// KV cache hit ratio per model
sum(kvcache_hits_total{job="serving"}) by (model) / sum(kvcache_requests_total{job="serving"}) by (model)

// eviction rate
rate(kvcache_evicts_total[5m])

// average kv bytes stored per shard
avg(kvcache_bytes{shard!=""}) by (shard)
```

anya: two dashboard/alerting asks: (1) surface when batch_utilization drops below 30% for >5m for any model lane, (2) alert when queue depth > X for 3+ routers indicating throttling/backpressure.

devon: need to pick X per capacity class. suggest we dimension alerts by capacity_tier (hosted/dedicated/private) and by model_complexity label. that way thresholds are realistic.

morgan: good call. also we should correlate token_budget violations — if observed tokens/sec > configured token_budget_target we should mark the run as "oversubscribe" and capture sample traces.

jules: for sampling, propose: 1% of oversubscribed batches capture full KV cache metadata (keys evicted, cache size) + request proto. store to short-term retention S3 bucket for postmortem. keep sampling flags in telemetry: sampled_batch=true.

morgan: agreed. we'll add a low-overhead debug flag so we don't dump every request. note: we must keep PII out of samples. sanitize prompts.

devon: on visualizations: want a single composite panel that shows (a) queue depth stacked by priority lane, (b) batch_utilization p50/p95 overlay, (c) token/sec per GPU line. helps troubleshoot whether low utilization stems from shallow queues or aggressive token caps.

morgan: i'm going to mock that panel in grafana. quick sketch of the composite PromQLs:

```promql
// stacked queue depth by priority
sum(queue_depth) by (priority)

// overlay: batch_util p95 across models
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(batch_util_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))

// token/sec per GPU line
sum(rate(tokens_emitted[1m])) by (gpu_id)
```

jules: we should tag traces with chosen kernel selection (e.g., float16-fused-attn-v2 vs default) to see if certain kernel choices increase microbatch latency or amplify queueing.

morgan: yes. add labels: kernel_variant, quant_level, gpu_type, seq_len_bucket. that will make dashboards sliceable.

anya: question about sampling volume — 1% seems fine, but for high-traffic models it may be too much. can we do dynamic sampling: fixed floor (0.05%) + pct of oversubscribe events capped at 1%?

devon: yep, dynamic sampling + backpressure-aware sampler is doable. we'll implement a token-bucket sampler in runtime that checks oversubscribe flag.

sre-bot: deploy scheduled: telemetry-proto branch will roll to staging at 2024-03-26T18:00Z. automated smoke tests include metric emission checks.

morgan: awesome. actions: (1) devon to add PromQL panels + alert rules PR, (2) jules to add KV cache metrics and labels for kernel variant, (3) anya to draft thresholds per capacity_tier, (4) me to wire the composite grafana panel + mock. target: staging by EOW.

anya: ack. will send threshold doc by EOD. :thumbsup:

devon: i'll open PR with queries + dashboard json, include a couple low-sample dashboards for high-traffic lanes.

morgan: cool — if possible include example traces and a short runbook: how to interpret stack (queue -> low-util -> kernel fallback). helps oncall troubleshoot. :eyes:

jules: will add a checklist for KV investigation: check hit_rate, recent evictions, per-shard memory pressure, and recent kernel changes.

morgan: thanks team. dropping mock link shortly. if anyone wants to jump in with more signal ideas call out here.
